property_summary: For any inputs admissible to initialize (i.e. any _feeRate <= 5000), the reference contract stores feeRate equal to the provided _feeRate, whereas the mutant sometimes increments the provided _feeRate so stored feeRate != _feeRate (the mutant therefore can differ for some fuzzed _feeRate values).
change_summary: Insert a statement that increments the provided _feeRate by 1 before assigning, so feeRate becomes _feeRate + 1 (unless capped elsewhere).
